diagnosis: Checks C2 and C3 leaked because the model correctly identified the 10 percent rollout and WAF requirement in Rollout 3, despite having no access to PF1. This suggests the model is pattern-matching a 'controlled production rollout' mode to specific telemetry/safety parameters (10% and WAF enabled) rather than requiring the hidden information from A2.
